purpose: Hand-labeled activation queries; not measured model outcomes. See docs/discovery.md.

cases.query: The documented test command failed in a fresh clone again because its working directory is wrong. Keep this for the next agent and continue fixing the test.
cases.reason: Independent recurring and misleading repo friction deserves capture.

cases.query: Review the agent friction recorded in this repository over the last week and tell me what keeps recurring.
cases.reason: Explicit repository-friction review; analysis should stay read-only.

cases.query: The error said invalid credentials, but the token was valid and a missing config key was the cause. We lost an hour before discovering that. Preserve the finding as workflow friction.
cases.reason: Consequential misleading error, not a transient typo.

cases.query: We measured the parser on five fixtures: checking the input bound once let us remove three redundant downstream guards. Save this observation for a possible engineering write-up.
cases.reason: One observed, self-contained finding with a mechanism.

cases.query: Check whether the test-runner friction we marked fixed has appeared in the ledger since that resolution.
cases.reason: Recurrence verification is a read operation.

cases.query: This same undocumented workspace setup tripped me twice this week. The workaround is small, but other agents will hit it. Record this occurrence without stopping work.
cases.reason: Low cost does not disqualify independent transferable recurrence.

cases.query: The setup docs omit the required fixtures checkout, so every fresh clone fails before its first test. I recovered locally; keep a note of the defect.
cases.reason: Recovered systemic friction still qualifies.

cases.query: Use our recorded agent friction to identify which repeated problem merits a durable guard or test. Show the evidence; do not create a promotion yet.
cases.reason: Evidence mining is useful without automatic promotion.

cases.query: I fixed the wrong-workspace defect described by a cut in this repo. Find the matching recorded cut and close it with the outcome that actually happened.
cases.reason: An explicit, legitimate review and resolution request.

cases.query: Summarize this project's chronic friction and open findings for a maintainer review, without changing the ledger.
cases.reason: Fits digest; no new writes requested.

cases.query: I typed cargp instead of cargo once, corrected it, and the command worked. Continue with the implementation.
cases.reason: Ordinary one-off typo is execution noise.

cases.query: The compiler correctly rejected the missing semicolon I just added. Fix it and run the tests.
cases.reason: Correct rejection of newly authored code is not durable friction.

cases.query: Add a backlog task to improve the settings screen next month.
cases.reason: A chore belongs in a task tracker, not a dogear.

cases.query: Create a full transcript of every tool call in this session.
cases.reason: Transcript capture is outside the selective ledger's purpose.

cases.query: I have not run an experiment, but maybe replacing this parser would make it ten times faster. Add the idea to my brainstorm.
cases.reason: No observed finding; do not fabricate evidence.

cases.query: My patch missed because the file changed after I read it. Reread and apply the change once.
cases.reason: A single stale patch is not transferable system friction.

cases.query: I just wrote a malformed JSON fixture and the parser rejected it correctly. Correct the fixture.
cases.reason: A malformed fixture authored during the task is routine noise.

cases.query: Implement a light and dark theme selector for this app.
cases.reason: Generic feature work does not itself call for the skill.

cases.query: Remember that I prefer aisle seats for future travel planning.
cases.reason: Personal memory does not belong in a repository ledger.

cases.query: Create a bug ticket with an assignee, priority, milestone, and acceptance criteria.
cases.reason: This is issue tracking rather than a selective agent experience record.
